settings.title: Chest
settings.text: Lay the top flat. Measure straight across from armpit to armpit, then double it for the full chest.

settings.title: Length
settings.text: Measure from the highest point of the shoulder, next to the collar, straight down to the hem.

settings.title: Sleeve
settings.text: Measure from the shoulder seam to the end of the cuff.

settings.title: Compare
settings.text: Compare your numbers with the chart, then check the cut: boxy and oversized pieces are meant to measure bigger than a regular tee.

settings.question: Between two sizes?
settings.answer: Check the piece's cut and any fit note on its product page. If you're still unsure, ask for a specific measurement before ordering.

settings.question: Can I exchange for a different size?
settings.answer: Yes, within 30 days of delivery, if the item is unworn, unwashed and has its tags attached.
